@graph.name: Is VOS a real BlueCart alternative, and is it better than BlueCart?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends entirely on why you were looking. On the repeat order from an account already on your book we would say VOS is better: your range only, your prices, approved by the buyer, with nothing rating you on the way through. If you want to be found by restaurants you do not supply, VOS cannot help and a marketplace is the right tool. That is their product and we do not have one.

@graph.name: Will VOS bring us new customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. VOS only serves the accounts on your own book, since each guide is built from what they buy from you. Anyone promising both acquisition and a private ordering channel in one product is worth a second question.

@graph.name: Does anything in VOS compare our prices for the buyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing. There is no value label, no benchmark and no other vendor in the app. BlueCart offers Pricing Insights that rank a listing by how good the value looks, which is a genuinely useful marketplace feature and the opposite of what a service-led distributor usually wants beside its catalog.

@graph.name: Does any of this touch our ERP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only to hand it the order. VOS works at the intake end and passes each one on, itemized and approved. Everything downstream behaves exactly as it did yesterday.

Neither of us publishes a figure. Theirs follows a demo; ours comes as a quote once we have talked. On a marketplace it is also worth asking what the commercial terms are around being listed, because being listed carries its own commercial terms, not a fee you are quoted.

@graph.name: How fast can accounts begin ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most distributors this is live inside 24 to 48 hours, with a first order usually in on the same day. BlueCart say theirs can be live within days, so on speed there is very little between us, and a BlueCart alternative is rarely chosen on that alone.

@graph.name: And the accounts that will only ever call?

acceptedAnswer.text: They carry on calling, and your desk deals with those the way it always has. Be clear about the limit though: a call or a voicemail gets no order number from VOS, no timestamp and nothing moving in stock. Only what comes through the app does.

@graph.name: Where do the BlueCart details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everything here came from bluecart.com, read 10 October 2026: the marketplace positioning off the headline, the Pricing Insights and endless aisle descriptions off their product list, and the setup line off their FAQ. We have left their transaction and funding figures alone, because those are theirs. If any of it has moved on, the fault is here, not there.
